responsibility: This header is GCC’s main public interface for machine modes. It declares the generated mode property tables such as size, precision, inner mode, unit count, next/wider relationships, defines the mode_class enum from mode-classes.def, supplies classification predicates and typed-mode query helpers, and provides iteration utilities for traversing mode classes or widening chains. It is the central API used by both tree and RTL code to reason about data representation modes and their relationships.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/machmode.def, which specifies the mode set declaratively for generation, this header provides the generated/public machine-mode API: property tables, classification predicates, typed wrappers, and iteration helpers used by compiler code.
